newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC raises US$150 mln in note issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC raises US$150 mln in note issue.

text.p: RGC Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise US$150 million through a note issue.
"RGC has completed, subject to due diligence, a debt raising of US$150 million through the issue of senior notes in the U.S. private placement market," RGC said.
"The issue is in tranches of eight, 10, 12 and 15 years and has been priced at between 85 and 110 basis points over U.S. Treasury bond yields," it said.
"The initial offering of US$125 million for tranches from eight to 12 years was heavily oversubscribed and there was also significant support for longer dated securities."
RGC Chairman Tony Cotton said he was delighted with the outcome of the long term issue, which matched the group's debt profile with its long term assets and completed the refinancing of the group.
"The pricing for such long dated maturities is excellent," Cotton said in a statement.
"With current net debt at just over A$200 million, the group now has a substantial financing capability with which to continue to pursue its growth strategy," he said.
RGC's shares closed down 11 cents at A$5.39 on Tuesday.
